notes: Behemoth overlay: a broken part stays BROKEN. The game refills or replaces a part's health when it breaks, and the break was only noticed if a health check landed on exactly 0; it now also comes from the game's own break state and break events, and once broken the part's later health is ignored until a new behemoth. Missing readings show as a dash instead of a number, out-of-range values are clamped, and a part no longer vanishes while the game replaces it. Settings tells you when copies of the game (hunt servers stay open between hunts) still run an older game mod.
